message: 従業員再教育研修

name: Synn
message: 「The reason I asked you all to gather here today is none other than...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's about Prier's new waitress, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It'd be one thing if it were just us, but we've been getting tons of complaints from other students.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How many are we talking?」

name: Synn
message: 「This many!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa!! There are really this many~」

name: Misa
message: 「All of these in just a few days.」

name: Synn
message: 「If this keeps up for a year, how many rolls of toilet paper could we even trade these for...」

name: Ria
message: 「Though at that rate, I wonder if she'll even last a month--or heck, even a week~?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Mysterious Waitress, Gunned Down in the Wasteland!」

name: Ria
message: 「'Bang!!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey now, don't say such violent things.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, wouldn't firing her out of nowhere be a bit too harsh?」

name: Misa
message: 「How kind of you, after how much she made a fool of us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The one she made a fool of was you, Madam Vice President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's definitely best if we can settle this peacefully.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that's why we're having a strategy meeting. Makes sense.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I can't believe you can talk like that right in front of the person herself, nya...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my~\s01」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even like this, Pasta is entertaining customers with plenty of hospitality in her own way, nya!! And yet you're all running your mouths saying whatever you please.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which is precisely why!! I think we should cleanly, clearly, distinctly, and plainly tell her the exact situation as it stands!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oho~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, Senpai. Please go ahead.」

name: Ria
message: 「If things keep going like this, we might have to let you go\s02」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyahaha! A mere student like you couldn't possibly have that kind of authority, nyan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, she's the director's little sister.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The director is the highest-ranking person in this entire academy, you know.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Which means if she puts in a word with them, Pasta is totally done for... Ginyaaa!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Surprisingly, her brain actually works.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What... Ria-senpai actually has that much pull?!」

name: Ria
message: 「No, I don't\s02」

name: Pasta
message: 「Unyaaa~~. Getting fired would be a huge problem, nyan!! Please do something about it, I'll work hard, nyan!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, there, what an obedient little kitty. If only you were this cooperative all the time.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyat was that?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if we report the actual situation, the problem remains unsolved. After all, Pasta-san still considers herself a waitress.」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's right. I'm trying my very best, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yet you have zero intention of actually improving.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, allow me to lend my assistance!! I call it Operation 'Close Call for a Waitress'!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To put it bluntly, Pasta-san's service is the absolute worst. She doesn't understand the first thing about customer service.」

name: Pasta
message: 「NYAT?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so! You will practice alongside me so that you can become a proper waitress!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see~」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're talking about teaching customer service, I think Nanaka is the best person for the job.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The treasurer is far too perfect. There is no way Pasta-san could ever imitate her!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now you're speaking my language.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I can't do it either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Spineless!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is why I shall offer myself up. I'm quite used to devoting myself to others, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't it just because you actually want to be a waitress yourself?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「G-Gulp!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fine, got it. Then I'll just shut up and watch!」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to go out of your way to announce it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come now, Pasta-san. Let's do our best together.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Meowww~~. I'm kinda not feeling it, but this is for Bylous-nyama too, nya...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone else, please act as the customers.」

name: Synn
message: 「You got it. Then, could I get some cold water first?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Water is full-service self-service, nya♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not right! You have to properly bring the water over to them. Like this, you see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh... Hot water suddenly coming out like that really startled me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay? Did you burn yourself?」

name: Pasta
message: 「How pathetic, nya. If it's just water, Pasta will go scoop some up in a flash, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ginyaaaa!!」
It seems she fell into the exact same trap.

name: Synn
message: 「It's the blue one, the blue button!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As expected of you, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, to me, it's basically a substitute for juice, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, how pitiful\s06」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I just can't help wanting to press the red one. Doesn't it look like it'll launch missiles or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That has nothing to do with ice water!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Could I get a wet towel next?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Here's your wet towel, nya」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, don't wring out a floor rag!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Then should I bring you a beer instead, nya?」

name: Ria
message: 「I believe that's the wrong kind of \{wringing|\s12\s12}\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry for the wait on the wet towels. Please take one from this tray~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thanks」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Lord Synn. Worked up a bit of a sweat, so let me wipe myself down」

name: Synn
message: 「Popping out of nowhere like that--」

name: Paqy
message: 「HOOOOOOOOT!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Told you so」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I thought wet towels were supposed to be warm, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's way too hot, you stupid angel!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wrap Mr. Panda in a white cloth and--presto! Now you're one of the angels too」

name: Paqy
message: 「St-Stoooooop. Ah, ajaaaah!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, to think she can't even handle the basics...」

name: Misa
message: 「This really is hopeless」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, they say a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Don't give up and keep at it. If you do, I'm sure...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll be able to do it? Can I really believe that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... ugh... y-you can do it, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I'll do my best!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaa~~. I'm already tired, nya~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you talking about? Next up is cooking!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't tell me we're the ones taste-testing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course you are. You are the customers, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「I have a bad feeling about this......」

name: Ria
message: 「Um...... should I help out a little?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That wouldn't be good practice!! We will definitely finish it with our own hands!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm so done~~!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm doing all of this for your sake, Pasta-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And the real reason?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've always wanted to step inside Prier's stylish, wonderful kitchen just once♪」

name: Synn
message: 「What an honest girl.」
Lolotte grabs Pasta by the scruff of the neck and disappears into the kitchen.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte sure is energetic, huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's amazing how you keep up with her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, right. Pasta really hangs in there too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I meant you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's done already?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no. Actually, I forgot to take your orders, ehehe. What would you like to eat?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, radish sprout ramen」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm fine with that too」

name: Misa
message: 「Me too...」

name: Ria
message: 「Me too\s02」
If it's just ramen, they should manage somehow as long as they follow the instructions.

name: Synn
message: 「Just one piece of advice」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Make sure you... actually taste-test it」

name: Lolotte & Pasta
message: 「Roger that!!」
And just like that, the two of them never came back.
